## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `AiDataMapping`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `ai-mapping`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **AiDataMapping**.

## Step 2: How to use

1. <!-- manual: Define the input and output record types in the Types panel. Define inner records first, then compose them into the parent input and output records. For details on creating records, see [Type editor](../../../understand-ide/editors/type-editor.md). -->
2. Create the data mapper. Under **Data Mappers** in the project explorer, select **+**. Set a name, add the input type with a parameter name, set the output type, and select **Create**.
3. <!-- manual: Create the data mapper. Under Data Mappers in the project explorer, select +. Set a name, add the input type with a parameter name, set the output type, and select Create. -->
4. The Data Mapper editor opens with the input schema on the left and the output schema on the right.
5. In the top-right corner of the canvas, select **Auto Map**. The WSO2 Integrator Copilot panel opens alongside the canvas with the `/data-map` skill preloaded.
6. <!-- manual: Submit it. The Copilot reads the project files, generates field mappings based on the input and output types, and integrates them into your workspace. When complete, mapping lines appear between the matched fields on the canvas. -->
